annotations.title: Check live rates for a hotel

description: Fetch live VICATOO rates for a hotel for the given check-in/check-out dates and occupancy. Returns up to `limit` rates with room name, price, meal type, bed type and cancellation policy. Booking itself always completes on vicatoo.com — to book, direct the guest to open the hotel page URL (the search_hotels card link already carries the dates and guests); never promise in-chat booking.

currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency for the rate prices. Defaults to USD so rates match the search-result prices; pass the same currency the guest saw in search.

hotel_id.description: VICATOO hotel id — numeric hid or slug (same as get_hotel_details).

residency.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the country the guest LIVES in - the supplier prices by it, and the hotel page link carries it. If the guest has not said where they live, leave it out and ask them first ("which country do you live in?", in their own language). Never assume US or any other country.

room_type_filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter on room_name.

view.description: Optional preferred view family (e.g. "bosphorus", "sea", "garden", "city", "pool"). When the guest cares about a specific view, pass it so matching-view rates are floated to the top instead of the default cheapest-first ordering.

name: check_availability
title: Check live rates for a hotel
